_comment: Presets referencing server:// use operator-mounted fine-tunes from MERGESE_CHECKPOINTS; the clone-detection models are task-specific CodeBERT/GraphCodeBERT/UniXcoder fine-tunes with real validation F1s in the 0.89-0.99 range (see each checkpoint's best_metrics.json).

presets.name: Inspect CodeBERT fine-tunes (BCB vs CLCDSA)
presets.description: Compare the task-vector geometry of two CodeBERT clone-detection fine-tunes trained on BigCloneBench vs CLCDSA. Shows pairwise cosine similarity + sign-agreement + architecture compatibility.

presets.name: Evaluate CodeBERT-BCB on BigCloneBench (expect F1 ~0.90)
presets.description: Direct evaluation of the pretrained CodeBERT fine-tune on bundled BigCloneBench (200 rows). Reproduces the ~0.90 F1 reported in best_metrics.json. No merging needed.

presets.name: Evaluate UniXcoder-CLCDSA on CLCDSA (expect F1 ~0.94)
presets.description: Direct evaluation of the pretrained UniXcoder fine-tune on bundled CLCDSA (cross-language, 200 rows). Reproduces the ~0.94 F1 reported in best_metrics.json.

presets.name: Evaluate UniXcoder-BCB on GPTCloneBench (OOD)
presets.description: Out-of-distribution evaluation: UniXcoder fine-tuned on BigCloneBench, tested on GPT-generated semantic clones.

presets.name: TIES merge: CodeBERT (BCB) + CodeBERT (CLCDSA)
presets.description: TIES-Merging across two CodeBERT clone-detection fine-tunes trained on different benchmarks. The merged encoder should carry signal from both.

presets.name: DARE-TIES merge: UniXcoder (BCB) + UniXcoder (CLCDSA)
presets.description: DARE-TIES across two UniXcoder clone-detection fine-tunes. Drops 30% of task-vector entries before TIES to reduce interference.

presets.name: WUDI merge: UniXcoder BCB + CLCDSA + crosslang
presets.description: WUDI-Merging across three UniXcoder clone-detection fine-tunes. 300 interference-minimising optimisation steps per linear layer at lr 1e-5.

presets.name: PCB merge: cross-base clone detectors (CodeBERT + GraphCodeBERT + UniXcoder on BCB)
presets.description: PCB-Merging across three RoBERTa-family clone detectors fine-tuned on BigCloneBench. Keeps the top 10% of competition scores globally; ideal for merging different backbones that saw the same task.

presets.name: Cross-task encoder merge (demo: public encoders)
presets.description: Encoder-only DARE-TIES across three public SE encoders. Demonstrates the --encoder-only path for merging checkpoints with mismatched classifier heads; the base's head is preserved so you can attach a fresh task-specific head downstream.
